about_the_game:
The game

Experience this colourful, varied reinterpretation of well-known strategy game classics such as ‘Advance Wars’ or ‘Nectaris’ in a fresh, fantastic new look on your PC.

Move & Attack

Move your troops across the playing field turn by turn.

Each turn, one unit can move and/or attack an opponent.

Move & Attack

Move your troops across the playing field in turns.

One unit can move and/or attack an opponent per turn.

A wide variety of units

There are different units with different strengths and weaknesses. For example, a catapult is extremely strong against units inside fortifications.

However, a catapult is not particularly mobile. During a turn, it can only move OR attack, which requires appropriate advance planning.

Priests, on the other hand, are weakly armoured and completely helpless in battle, but can heal other units and, more importantly, teleport foot troops over long distances!

Experience

Your units gain experience through battles, represented by a growing star. The more experienced a unit is, the more powerful it becomes in battle.

And heroes, of course!

Your hero enters the playing field via the main fortress. Heroes can either fight and conquer villages, search for treasures, hunt monsters or occupy magical rune fields.

When conquered, these runes trigger permanent boosts for your army. These last until another hero can conquer them.

Heroes also provide many tactical options. For example, special hero units can be acquired in the main fortress or powerful special actions can be triggered.

Features

  • Strong and dynamic AI

  • A variety of unlockable battles

  • Varied campaign

  • Different heroes with their own special units and special actions

  • Multiplayer in hotseat and LAN mode (further modes in preparation)

  • Unlockable map generator

  • Many tactical features such as ‘fog of war’, ‘experience’, ‘flank protection’, etc.

  • Gamepad support

Details

Defeat your opponent on a playing field organised into hexes.

The playing field contains various terrains such as forests, mountains and lakes.

Furthermore, there are towns, castles, harbours, strongholds, fortresses and more. These towns must be conquered and held by foot troops.

This allows you to increase your gold income and recruit many different units.

The heroes play a special role. They enter the playing field via your main fortress and can take part in the battle. They can also collect treasure chests, conquer powerful rune fields or fight creatures.

If you have collected enough souls through battles, heroes can perform a particularly powerful special action to turn the battle in your favour.

Only with tactical skill and foresight can you defeat the computer opponent or other players.

name: Deep Tactics - Journey of the Wizard

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5, AMD® Ryzen™ 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 10-Series, AMD® Radeon™ 500-Series
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7, AMD® Ryzen™ 7 5700X / Ryzen™ 5 7600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 10-Series or better, AMD® Radeon™ RX 5000-Series or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Enter the fascinating world of turn-based tactical games and let yourself be carried away into a captivating story about heroes, castles and wizards. With a sophisticated AI and a variety of unique units, the game offers impressive depth of play and strategic variety.
